[IALC.1.3] `ds_alloc.c` holds the only legitimate raw libc allocation
calls. In `DS_ALLOC_WEAK` mode it defines the six `ds_*` functions with
`__attribute__((weak))`, each forwarding to its libc counterpart. In
`DS_ALLOC_MACRO` mode it defines the real (non-weak) exported functions
the public ABI and the protobuf shim require (at least `ds_free` and
`ds_malloc`) as thin wrappers over the macros.
